symbolic_record_geometry: Theta(E) governed response-event records, where E counts substantive and typed/non-substantive events needed for topology/routing replay; event payload includes M01-M07,M10,M17-M18 refs
invalidation_or_retention_condition: must preserve event/group/rank/order/topology/native+canonical identity; may use any injective encoding

symbolic_record_geometry: Theta(G) observed respondent-coordinate facts within future-authorized frontier; G<=R*I only in dense respondent×coordinate representation and may be sparse
invalidation_or_retention_condition: future-authorizable coordinate/value/time/native semantics and crosswalk authority must remain exact

symbolic_record_geometry: Theta(R_scope + U) identity records or information-equivalent keys/maps; exact byte width representation-dependent
invalidation_or_retention_condition: cross-universe ID strings never merged absent exact linkage; raw and canonical scope both retained

symbolic_record_geometry: Theta(Z) explicit respondent-question eligibility/routing facts, or smaller deterministic rules plus their required parent-event inputs when exactly information-equivalent
invalidation_or_retention_condition: must reproduce exact member sets and typed not-asked/inapplicable states for future authorized risk sets

symbolic_record_geometry: Theta(R_w) respondent weight facts across governed weight bases plus Theta(A_w) design/estimand authorities
invalidation_or_retention_condition: raw measure remains reconstructible; missing/invalid weight cannot be unit-filled generically

symbolic_record_geometry: Theta(A+X+L+P_rec) content-addressed authority/crosswalk/universe-relation/replay records; exact count depends on versions and receipts, not respondent count alone
dominant_size_axes: authority versions;source releases;crosswalk entries;search/branch receipts;structural admissions
invalidation_or_retention_condition: all referenced identities immutable/dereferenceable; semantic hash covers every proof-relevant field

symbolic_record_geometry: sum over cached fixed queries of response-cell count; roughly Theta(sum_m C_target,m) plus fact identity/provenance
dominant_size_axes: number of cached E1 facts;C_q;condition/source/risk-set variants
invalidation_or_retention_condition: valid only exact fixed conditioner/target/risk-set/scope/topology/measure authority identity

symbolic_record_geometry: sparse Theta(sum_m M_2,m) occupied cells plus response domains/provenance; dense representation would Theta(sum_m C_a*C_b)
invalidation_or_retention_condition: fixed bounded pair only; new conditioner/risk set/target requires C11 replay

symbolic_record_geometry: sparse Theta(sum_m M_J,m), M_J<=min(N_joint,product_j C_j), plus target-domain/predicate/provenance records; dense Cartesian product is not required by D12
invalidation_or_retention_condition: cache scope fixed by exact condition/targets/arity/risk set/topology/measure/source authority

symbolic_record_geometry: compact receipt Theta(B_rec * receipt_width) is required when historical branch/result replay is required; explicit member caches add Theta(sum_b N_b)
dominant_size_axes: number of recorded discoveries/branches;B;D;F;optional member counts
invalidation_or_retention_condition: member sets are optional if deterministic replay from C11+receipt is exact; branch label/support alone insufficient

symbolic_record_geometry: rules/crosswalks Theta(X); past-query receipts Theta(N_comp_receipts) only when exact historical reverse-query replay is required
dominant_size_axes: comparator rule count;crosswalk cardinality;source/time variants;reverse query count
invalidation_or_retention_condition: rule authority M13 required; individual receipt can be omitted when past result identity need not be preserved and rule can be rerun from retained actor fact ref

symbolic_record_geometry: Theta(N_admit) query/fact-to-structural-authority receipts or immutable references
dominant_size_axes: number of admitted empirical facts;producer versions;source/time variants
invalidation_or_retention_condition: must bind exact empirical fact identity and structural admission/negative authority

symbolic_record_geometry: Theta(P_diag) pair/network rows for chosen diagnostic set; current V550 emits <=P_state selected modal-cell rows
invalidation_or_retention_condition: no terminal retention status; invalidate on input contingency/risk-set/metric/algorithm change

symbolic_record_geometry: Theta(A_diag) scalar/vector metric rows over chosen exact contingencies
invalidation_or_retention_condition: noninvertible; invalidate when contingency/metric/weight/risk-set version changes

symbolic_record_geometry: Theta(B_current) current tree node rows; D14A current code bound B_q<=2^(min(D,I_q)+1)-1 before pruning
invalidation_or_retention_condition: not physical authority for recursive discovery; current algorithm semantics needed only for historical replay

symbolic_record_geometry: write events count 9*Q_exec+3*Q_cloud+Q_gap plus Q_handled completion markers; row/byte volume equals checkpointed artifacts
invalidation_or_retention_condition: operational recovery value unmeasured; not terminal information class

symbolic_record_geometry: Theta(B_source) source bytes plus catalog/hash/interpretation provenance; exact B_source unknown
invalidation_or_retention_condition: D13 does not authorize deletion; retain as safety/evidence until positive injective source->C11 equivalence and later governance decision

symbolic_record_geometry: C11 necessary geometry + source bytes + selected E1/E2/E3/E4/cache records; strictly >= C11 information footprint absent representation compression interactions
dominant_size_axes: all C11 axes + source bytes + cache population
invalidation_or_retention_condition: use only as upper-bound/reference lane; nonminimal by D13
